search.query: index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_CMD | eval Command=urldecode(ltrim(replace(cmd,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval Command=if(isnull(Command), cmd, Command) | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | search acct=$user_token1$ | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(host) AS host values(acct) AS User values(cwd) AS CWD values(res) AS Result by Command | table _time host User Command CWD Result count | sort - _time

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE | eval arg0=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a0,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg0=if(isnull(arg0), a0, arg0) | eval arg1=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a1,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg1=if(isnull(arg1), a1, arg1) | eval arg2=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a2,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg2=if(isnull(arg2), a2, arg2) | eval arg3=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg3=if(isnull(arg3), a3, arg3) | eval cmdline=coalesce(arg0, "") + " " + coalesce(arg1, "") + " " + coalesce(arg2, "") + " " + coalesce(arg3, "") | eval cmdline=trim(replace(cmdline, "\s+", " ")) | join msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL | table msg pid exe ] | join msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=CWD | table msg cwd ] | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | search acct=$user_token1$ | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(host) AS host values(acct) AS User values(exe) AS Executable values(cwd) AS CWD BY cmdline | table _time host User CWD cmdline Executable count | sort - _time
